title: The Pawn Grab
setup: Black has just taken a pawn on b2 with its rook, leaving its eighth rank completely bare.
hint: The black king has three of its own pawns directly in front of it. What does that leave it?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Re8#}}. The king on g8 has f7, g7 and h7 blocked by its own pawns, and every square on the eighth rank belongs to the rook. A king behind three unmoved pawns is one back-rank check from mate whenever nothing guards that rank.
